fees.description:
This is a charge from your distribution company. OVO Energy will only ever pass the exact cost through to you. Site attendance – a fee (inc GST) may be charged for re‑energisation where attendance is required. Remote re‑energisation incurs no fee.
OVO Energy reserves the right to and will notify you if it changes or imposes additional fees or charges in relation to your energy supply. Please refer to ovoenergy.com.au/fees for more information.

incentives.eligibility: OVO Energy pay 3% interest on credit balances (after all monthly charges are considered). This is prorated for the number of days since your last bill.

eligibility.information: Monthly electronic billing and bill smoothed in advance direct debit are both required. Available to all customers on the applicable network tariff code
